Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

RLAIF: Scaling Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with AI Feedback (arXiv 2309.00267v1) · paper method: In this v1 summarization study, PaLM2 Large generates preference labels and PaLM2 Extra-Small initializes the models; RL uses modified A2C rather than PPO.

RLAIF: Scaling Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with AI Feedback (arXiv 2309.00267v1) · human annotation: Human policy evaluation uses 1,200 ratings: evaluators rank RLAIF, RLHF, SFT and human-reference summaries without ties for held-out TL;DR posts.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

RLAIF: Scaling Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with AI Feedback (arXiv 2309.00267v1) · paper method: For each summary pair, the AI labeler is queried twice with reversed candidate order and the resulting preference distributions are averaged to mitigate position bias.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

RLAIF: Scaling Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with AI Feedback (arXiv 2309.00267v1) · evaluates on: Human evaluators prefer RLAIF summaries to SFT 71% of the time and RLHF to SFT 73%; the paper reports the difference as not statistically significant and RLAIF versus RLHF as 50%.
